## RZJoin

**RZJoin** plugin sends welcome messages when users join the server, easy to use, flexible settings.

## Features
- Multi-language support (EN/RU) with customizable messages.
- Flexible settings.
- Debug mode for server admins.

## Commands
```
/rzj help - Show help (Показать помощь)
/rzj reload - Reload plugin (Перезагрузить конфиг)
```
